Exact commands and verification order From a **configured, authorized multi-repo development checkout** of `ghatana-media` with the matching public/packed Ghatana package dependencies (source-composite development and installed-public-artifact verification are **separate** runs): ```bash # Wave 0: always start with authoritative regeneration, NEVER edit generated JSON directly. pnpm generate:product-definition-manifest node scripts/generate-media-phase-projections.mjs node scripts/generate-media-phase-projections.mjs --check --strict # Fast source/semantic regressions introduced in merged owner decisions. pnpm test:owner-source-selections pnpm test:typed-contract-bindings pnpm check:product-definition-authority pnpm check:product-experience-local pnpm test:product-definition-authority pnpm test:product-experience-local # Source-level parity and design gates. Non-zero is an actionable finding until resolved. node --test tests/media-contract-parity.test.mjs tests/media-design-conformance.test.mjs pnpm check:contract-parity pnpm check:design-conformance pnpm check:presentation-architecture pnpm test:presentation-architecture # Public package/host and Lifecycle input consumers. pnpm test:tools-media-consumer pnpm test:shared-media-consumer pnpm check:lifecycle-closure-inputs pnpm test:lifecycle-input-preflight pnpm test:lifecycle-consumer-artifact # Full affected browser smoke and scenario review when GUI/Explorer sources change. pnpm test:experience-browser git diff --check ``` **Do not run these commands assuming every pre-existing task must pass today.** `check:contract-parity`, `check:design-conformance`, and Lifecycle *phase admission* may legitimately be non-green; isolate the failed source identities and fix them. A Lifecycle **input** preflight PASS with `PENDING`, no providers and zero receipts is **not phase closure**. Native Lifecycle proof commands must be obtained from and invoked through its current supported public CLI; do not guess private scripts/flags or import owner-internal files. ### Required negative test matrix | Change/fault injected | What must fail or be preserved | |---|---| | Unregistered/new ProductDefinition field, component, recipe, type, source ID | Public validator/ref closure and exact field mapper reject it | | Capability removed to reduce denominator | Registry/denominator preservation fails | | Multi-actor journey first-actor inferred silently | Actor/priority/authority mapping fails | | Wire route, SDK method or gRPC RPC silently renamed | Method+route+type+consumer parity fails | | Stale job attempt, expired token or wrong tenant | Canonical operation/effect authorizer rejects write/dispatch | | Cancel request or watcher detach mapped to `CANCELLED` | State/finality invariant fails | | Timeout or lost acknowledgment mapped to `FAILED`, automatically replayed | Outcome-unknown/reconciliation oracle fails | | Partial result accepted without sub-effect accounting | Partial finality contract fails | | Unsupported codec/model/voice or unknown rights | Capability admission rejects and UI/API reports reason | | Unknown Shared token, absent template/layout or private import | Design conformance and package consumer reject it | | Fake browser/AT review or empty human signature | Independent acceptance stays not-run | | Missing case/observer/oracle/provider or forged receipt | Lifecycle preflight/admission rejects premature readiness | | Normative source changed but proof reused with stale fingerprint | Lifecycle currentness/reproof rejects it | ## 12. How to split work into bounded implementation batches **Batch discipline:** Each PR addresses one coherent owner and dependency slice and leaves the repository in a locally honest, testable state. Avoid enormous bulk rewrites of 462 leaves/349 blocks/47 screens in one change. Process by capability/operation family or journey, preserve stable IDs, and regenerate affected projections after source edits. Cross-repository PRs should be submitted to their owners, never copied into Media private trees. **Suggested concurrent batches:** | Lane | Initial bounded changes | Other lane dependency | |---|---|---| | A — Regeneration & source truth | G-01/G-02/G-03/G-04, make 306-source manifest and 12/6/14 truth current | None | | B — PDP-0 semantics | P0-03 migration claim extraction in small source slices; P0-04 actor/intent mapping | G-03, later canonical PDP-1 refs | | C — PDP-1 interfaces | P1-06 TS binding tests; P1-03 caption version/read/write operations; P1-04 parity groups | G-02, authority selected | | D — PDP-2 design | P2-01 fresh six-field mapper; P2-05 recipe/template/layout selection; P2-02 Shared consumer | G-02, Shared public contract | | E — PDP-3 first vertical | P3-03 J-01/J-02/J-03/J-20 verified stages; P3-05 negative fixtures and P3-06 shared renderer | PDP-1 action/state and PDP-2 template semantics | | F — Proof system | L-01 exact 318 scope and L-02 case plan adapter from real tests | None to start; proof admission needs owner X-01/X-02 | | G — Owner-bound public packages | X-01 Tools #30, X-02 Lifecycle #1, X-03 Shared #234 | All can start in parallel | ### Immediate first PR checklist - [ ] Run the post-merge regeneration and capture the **new** actual semantic blocker counts and source diff; fix generator/compiler/public schema errors, not generated outputs by hand. - [ ] Run `pnpm test:typed-contract-bindings` and `pnpm test:owner-source-selections`; resolve real failures in source or assertions and confirm correct case sensitivity/unique semantic refs. - [ ] Make source-mapping residual reporting deterministic and list every remaining ID/owner, not just totals. - [ ] Re-run contract parity and design conformance; preserve the non-green reasons, classify them as schema/source/semantic/independent/external. - [ ] Start the Tools/Lifecycle/Shared owner dependencies in parallel (existing issues linked above). - [ ] Select one vertical (caption source upload → job → transcript → corrected caption version) as an *end-to-end semantic acceptance exemplar*, with real state/operation/interface/source proof, and then roll out the same source-owned pattern by family without copying definitions. ## 13.
